description: This Java source file defines a factory class 'PoliciesModelFactory' for creating various policy-related objects in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides static methods to instantiate protocols entities such as Labels, SubjectIssuers, Subjects, Resources, PolicyEntries, Policies, and related identifiers, as well as methods for creating collections of these objects. The class also includes utility methods for parsing JSON representations into policy objects and supports building complex policies through fluent builders.

classes.name: PoliciesModelFactory
classes.description: A final class providing static factory methods to create policy-related objects such as Labels, Subjects, Resources, Policy Entries, Policies, and various identifiers, as well as methods to parse JSON representations and build complex policy objects.

methods.name: newLabel
methods.description: Creates or returns a Label object given a CharSequence value. If the input is already a Label, it is cast and returned.

methods.name: newSubjectIssuer
methods.description: Creates a new immutable SubjectIssuer object from the provided character sequence.

methods.name: newSubjectId
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectId object from an issuer SubjectIssuer and a subject CharSequence.

methods.name: newSubjectId (CharSequence)
methods.description: Creates or returns a SubjectId from a character sequence which may already be a SubjectId.

methods.name: newSubjectType
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectType object from the provided character sequence.

methods.name: newSubject
methods.description: Creates a new Subject object with a given SubjectId and optional SubjectType.

methods.name: newSubject (with JSON object)
methods.description: Creates a new Subject based on issuer ID and a JSON object representing the Subject.

methods.name: emptySubjects
methods.description: Returns an empty Subjects collection.

methods.name: newSubjects (with iterable)
methods.description: Creates a Subjects collection from an iterable of Subject objects.

methods.name: newSubjects (with Subject and varargs)
methods.description: Creates a Subjects collection from individual Subject objects.

methods.name: newSubjects (with JSON object)
methods.description: Creates Subjects from a JSON representation.

methods.name: newResourceKey (CharSequence)

methods.name: splitTypeWithPath
methods.description: Splits a string into type and path parts based on delimiter.

methods.name: newResourceKey (type, path)
methods.description: Creates a ResourceKey from type and path.

methods.name: newResourceKey (JsonPointer)

methods.name: newResource
methods.description: Creates a Resource with type, path, and effected permissions.

methods.name: newResource (with ResourceKey and JsonValue)
methods.description: Creates a Resource with specified ResourceKey and permissions.

methods.name: newResource (with ResourceKey and EffectedPermissions)
methods.description: Creates a Resource with specified ResourceKey and permissions.

methods.name: emptyResources
methods.description: Returns an empty Resources collection.

methods.name: newResources (with iterable)
methods.description: Creates Resources from an iterable of Resource objects.

methods.name: newResources (with resources and varargs)

methods.name: newResources (with JSON object)

methods.name: newEffectedPermissions

methods.name: newPolicyRevision

methods.name: newPermissions (with collection)

methods.name: newPolicyEntries (from JSON object)
